policies.name: Signed-in readers can read entitled chapter pages
policies.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM chapters c
  WHERE ((c.id = chapter_pages.chapter_id) AND (lower(COALESCE(c.status, ''::text)) = 'published'::text) AND ((c.chapter_number IS NULL) OR (c.chapter_number <= 8) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM user_subscriptions us
          WHERE ((us.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (us.plan_id <> 'free'::text) AND (((us.status = 'active'::text) AND ((us.current_period_end IS NULL) OR (us.current_period_end > now()))) OR ((us.status = 'cancelled'::text) AND (us.current_period_end IS NOT NULL) AND (us.current_period_end > now())))))))))) OR private.is_admin())
